/.title: Maldon Spice | Indian Restaurant in Maldon, Essex
/.description: Indian restaurant on Maldon High Street. Clay-oven tandoori grills, vegan and dairy-free options and a full allergen guide. Open Tuesday to Sunday, 5pm to 10pm.
